sloka: महाबलो महाबाहुः वाली विपुल विक्रमः ।जुगोप भुज वीर्येण ऋक्ष गोपुच्छ वानरान् ॥१-१७-३५॥
transliteration: mahābalo mahābāhuḥ vālī vipula vikramaḥ ।jugopa bhuja vīryeṇa ṛkṣa gopuccha vānarān ॥1-17-35॥

translations.english: In order to assist Rama, this earth was filled with commanders of those who led the monkey forces resembling masses of clouds and mountains. They loan endowed with immense strength and fearful forms and countenances. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
